@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+Description: Disable on-demand ("dynamic") plugins by default in the archive build
+ The plugin manager's on-demand plugin channel lets the agent receive
+ `CONFIGURE_PLUGIN_STATES` messages over ACS, fetch a plugin archive from a
+ control-plane supplied URL, unpack it under `/var/lib/google-guest-agent` and
+ execute it (as root). However these plugin binaries never pass through the Ubuntu
+ archive and therefore receive no community review or CVE tracking.
+ This patch "flips" the compiled in default to false so that a plain old
+ `apt install google-guest-agent` leaves the channel off and doesn't
+ remove the feature (it still remains a one line opt-in). Enabling it again
+ is unaffected by this patch as configuration is merged per-key over the
+ compiled defaults from (in ascending order of precedence):
+ `/etc/default/instance_configs.cfg`, `.distro` and finally `.template`. Setting:
+   [Core]
+   on_demand_plugins = true
+ in any of those files will restore it back to the upstream behaviour. Canonical's
+ published Ubuntu GCE images set this at image build time.
+
+ (A note for anyone adding an image-level override) write
+ /etc/default/instance_configs.cfg and _not_ `.distro`. `.distro` has
+ _higher_ precedence than a user's own `instance_configs.cfg` so enabling
+ the channel there would silently override a users who later tries to turn
+ back off.
+Author: Chloé 'kajiya' Smith <chloe.smith@canonical.com>
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/google-guest-agent/+bug/2164943
+Last-Update: 2026-11-12
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: http://dep.debian.net/deps/dep3/
+--- a/google-guest-agent/internal/cfg/cfg.go
++++ b/google-guest-agent/internal/cfg/cfg.go
+@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ cloud_logging_enabled = true
+ log_level = 3
+ log_verbosity = 0
+ log_file =
+-on_demand_plugins = true
++on_demand_plugins = false
+ acs_client = true
+ enable_local_plugins = true
+
